name: browser-use
headline: Dan Koe Validator: Style Editor
short_description: Validates and edits articles to match Dan Koe's distinctive writing style, scoring across 7 dimensions with line-by-line rewrites and clear Pass/Fail verdicts.
author: antoinersx

sections.overview:
This skill turns Claude into a Dan Koe-style editor for newsletters, articles, and long-form content. It scores your writing across seven dimensions—Voice, Structure, Conviction, Conceptual Depth, Rhythm, Philosophy Alignment, and Practical Utility—then provides line-by-line rewrites with rationale for every change. The validator applies Dan Koe's distinctive approach: direct second-person address, zero hedging, reframed concepts, and structured frameworks. Upload your draft, get a Pass/Fail verdict (7.0/10 threshold), and learn the style through specific edits rather than vague feedback. Ideal for creators, writers, and entrepreneurs building in their own voice.
Validate newsletter drafts before publishing
Rewrite articles to remove hedging and increase conviction
Score long-form content against Dan Koe's 7 dimensions
Learn Dan Koe's writing style through before/after edits
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/antoinersx/dan-koe-validator`
sections.usage:
```
Please validate and edit the following article to match Dan Koe's writing style. Ensure the content is concise, engaging, and maintains a conversational tone. The article is about [TOPIC] and is intended for an audience interested in [INDUSTRY]. Here is the article: [ARTICLE].
```
Copy

```
# Edited Article: The Future of [TOPIC] in [INDUSTRY]
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
